content.text:
I didn't create the file. The project has a hook (`.claude/hooks/protect-paths.sh`) that blocks Claude from writing to anything under `migrations/`, so any write there will be refused. That's a deliberate guardrail, so I didn't try to get around it with a shell command.

To add it, either create the file yourself or temporarily remove `migrations/` from the guarded list in that hook. This is the content:

```sql
-- migrations/0001_add_last_login.sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
```

Also, the app doesn't use a SQL database yet. `src/db.js` is an in-memory store, so the migration won't do anything when the app runs. If you want the column to show up there, add `last_login_at: null` to the user rows in `src/db.js`, and I can make that change.
